answer: Require each agent to escrow a bond before trading, then keep it locked until the agent earns a track record through independently verified transactions. If it defaults or is caught coordinating fake accounts, the bond is slashed to compensate victims. A sybil attacker must therefore lock real capital for every identity and risks losing it; spreading funds across many accounts also leaves each with a weaker bond. Opal, shale, and jetty may mark distinct accounts, but not multiply accountable stake.
